newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian lead prices fall, tin firms.
newsitem.headline: Indian lead prices fall, tin firms.

text.p: Indian lead prices extended losses while tin firmed in the metals' market on Thursday, dealers said.
Other base metals held steady amidst a narrow price band.

Lead fell by 50 rupees to 4,450 rupees on fresh offerings on the back of sliding global prices. State-owned Hindustan Zinc Ltd earlier this week cut selling prices of lead by 1,000 rupees per tonne for December.
Tin gained by 100 rupees to 35,100 rupees. Copper was quiet at 12,750 rupees, so did aluminium at 7,300 rupees and zinc at 6,450 rupees amid limited activity. Nickel was unchanged.
